secrets.name: MP_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional: Mercado Pago access token from its developer dashboard; only needed for live payments.

secrets.name: MP_DEVICE_ID
secrets.description: Optional: Mercado Pago Point device ID; only needed for terminal payments.

secrets.name: FTP_HOST
secrets.description: Optional: product-image FTP hostname from your hosting provider.

secrets.name: FTP_USER
secrets.description: Optional: product-image FTP username from your hosting provider.

secrets.name: FTP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Optional: product-image FTP password from your hosting provider.

secrets.name: FTP_IMAGE_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional: public HTTPS base URL corresponding to the FTP product images.
